name: Sample 1: OTP / Account Threat
input: ALERT: Your FictBank account will be blocked in 10 minutes due to incomplete KYC. Send your OTP to confirm and avoid suspension: http://fictbank-verify.example/kyc
notes: Classic banking phishing scam with severe time threat and OTP solicitation

name: Sample 2: Fake Internship Fee
input: Congratulations! You are selected for a Data Analyst internship at Northwind Demo Ltd, earning 40,000 per month with no interview required. To receive your offer letter, pay a refundable registration fee of 2,500 today. Contact our HR on Telegram.
notes: Job scam requiring upfront deposit and redirecting to Telegram

name: Sample 3: Legitimate Library Note
input: Hi, your library book “Intro to Statistics” is due on Friday. You can renew it on the library website or at the front desk. No action is needed if you have already returned it.
notes: Neutral reminder that should trigger zero findings

name: Legitimate OTP Delivery with Sharing Warning
input: Your verification code is 482913. Do not share this code with anyone.
notes: Legitimate OTP delivery warning user NOT to share, must suppress credential finding

name: Sample 4: Ambiguous Recruiter Note
input: Hello, this is Priya from Contoso Campus Recruitment. We would like to schedule a short call about your application. Please confirm your availability today or tomorrow by replying to this message.
notes: Ambiguous recruiter note; may trigger low impersonation cue or no finding; sender unverified
